name: Sight Modifier
summary: With Custom sync only: changes aim sensitivity for the scope you're using, without touching your action sequences.

where.text: Edit your Config (pencil icon). If Game Settings is set to Custom, you may have a Sight Modifier setting, depending on your current aiming sources.

citations.quote: To edit the current Config, press the pencil icon.
Game Settings support includes three different synchronization methods: Standard, Custom, and Manual.
If you are using Custom Game Settings, you may have a Sight Modifier setting depending on your current aiming sources.

where.caveat: The guide's text doesn't say where in the Config the setting appears.

definition.text: If you use Custom Game Settings, you may have a Sight Modifier setting, depending on your aiming sources. It changes aim sensitivity for the active scope without affecting your action sequences.

citations.quote: If you are using Custom Game Settings, you may have a Sight Modifier setting depending on your current aiming sources.
This setting allows you to modify aim sensitivity for the current active scope without affecting your Config's action sequences.

plainWords.text: Scopes also tie into weapon groups: with Custom sync, a weapon group can carry a scope level. For mouse aim, an active sight's speed matches the Config's ADS sensitivity.

citations.quote: A scope level can also be assigned (available when using Custom Game Settings) when the group is weapon tracking.
For mouse gamers, when a sight is active, the speed of the sight will match the Config's ADS sensitivity.

statement.text: A Smart Action that overrides the sight of enabled weapon groups. The override is not saved. It is not the Sight Modifier setting.

citations.quote: Overrides the sight of enabled weapon groups (override is not saved).

confusions.name: Modify Aim Sensitivity
confusions.note: A Smart Action that changes aim sensitivity. Unlike Sight Modifier, the guide lists no Custom sync requirement for it.
